notes.title: New weapons and gameplay features!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30902591/6268c8fde894c9dc29643eaf459d337d41462af1.png[/img]

Hello everyone! its been a while since our last update, but we are still at work! Through the feedback from previous iterations and live performance at the retrocon convention we made a fresh new build for your appreciation 🙂

Laying the groundwork for the new highscore system:
-Energy crystals now earn points multiplied by combo meter
-Holding onto crystals will make them bigger and more valuable!
-Score points earned now visible with big numbers!

New Weapons!
-2 new special weapons available from the start of the game!

Streamlined game start
-now the game has a how-to-play preview video on the title menu showcasing basic gameplay actions and control inputs
-less text before starting a new campaign

Ingame menus localization for French and Portuguese
Many minor bug fixes and balancing ^^ 

Look forward to new content and features on the next updates, we are inching closer to the full release 😄

notes.title: This is just the beginning!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30902591/ebbd750b357d1003e3e8eba11e69c6a18d802560.png[/img]
Little over a month since the early access has been released, and we got a lot of useful feedback, thanks to that we already made tons of bug fixes, balancing and added features, including:

- softer difficulty curve from stage 0-0 to 1-0
- adjusts on cost and damage on all weapons
- adjusts on weapon energy gauge
- removal of scree shake o several enemies
- option to show ship hitbox
- and many bugfixes!

There are many other updates planned for the next months so please board on this journey with us! ^^

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30902591/39fcb975ab1efb22ad023e0b71fc9100af06e2be.png[/img]

Railgunners is out!


Railgunners is a story driven shooter, built to highly customizable difficulty levels.

Fight your way through hundreds of enemy ships, and help humanity fight back against the alien invasion!



Built to be a jump point into the shoot’em up genre but also a fun replayable challenge for veterans.

 Every run can be wildly different, preventing players from going into memorized automatic choices, creating a gripping and entertaining experience every run, even on easier stages.


The game offers many customization options: multiple characters, special weapons and items to customize the build of the ship; each stage rewards the player with a new tool to customize their playstyle, so they can shape the experience to their liking, with mods to make easier to manage energy, tank damage or manipulate risk/reward dynamics, and weapons to deal with specific enemy combinations; More hardcore players can also opt to not use those tools for organic challenges to test their grit.


Features


3 playable characters with unique balancing and skills


17 Carefully handcrafted levels

 

Branching paths


Procedural enemy placement, it’s not enough to mimic your past movements, learn to read the enemy and act accordingly


Gorgeous Pixelart


Customize your ship with weapons and mods!


Challenging gameplay, be ready to sharpen your reflexes!


High replayability!

notes.title: We're back and with a new demo!
notes.notes: After a loooong hiatus, many things happened in the background, but we are happy to finally bring you an updated demo, and we can see a clear path to the full release in a near future! In this demo you wil see a new gameplay loop and a glimpse to the type of flow we are aiming for the full game, but , so we could better evaluate on the performance of players and the balance of difficulty we decided to cut some features for this demo, like the upgrades and the other characters, but dont worry! they will all be back in an even better shape! So please, feel free to download this new demo and give it a try! remember to follow us for new updates, and leave your feedback in the community center!
